    """Convert C standard datetime format codes to a regex pattern.

    Supports common strftime/strptime format codes:
      %Y - Year with century (e.g., 1997)
      %y - Year without century (00-99)
      %m - Month as zero-padded decimal (01-12)
      %B - Full month name
      %b, %h - Abbreviated month name
      %d - Day of month as zero-padded decimal (01-31)
      %a - Abbreviated weekday name
      %A - Full weekday name
      %H - Hour (24-hour clock) as zero-padded decimal (00-23)
      %I - Hour (12-hour clock) as zero-padded decimal (01-12)
      %p - Locale's AM or PM
      %M - Minute as zero-padded decimal (00-59)
      %S - Second as zero-padded decimal (00-61)
      %f - Microsecond as decimal (000000-999999)
      %z - UTC offset in form ±HHMM[SS[.ffffff]] (empty string if naive)
      %Z - Timezone name (empty string if naive)
      %c - Locale's appropriate date and time representation
      %x - Locale's appropriate date representation
      %X - Locale's appropriate time representation
      %% - A literal '%' character

    Args:
        fmt: A string containing C standard datetime format codes.

    Returns:
        A regex pattern string that matches the format.
    """
    i = 0
    n = len(fmt)
    result = []

    while i < n:
        if fmt[i] == '%':
            if i + 1 >= n:
                raise ValueError("Format string ends with '%'")

            code = fmt[i + 1]
            i += 2

            if code == '%':

            elif code == 'Y':

            elif code == 'y':

                result.append(r'(%s)' % months_full)

            elif code == 'd':

            elif code == 'a':
                days = ['Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri', 'Sat', 'Sun']
                result.append(r'(%s)' % '|'.join(days))
            elif code == 'A':

                             'Friday', 'Saturday', 'Sunday']

            elif code == 'H':
                result.append(r'(\d{1,2})')
            elif code == 'I':

            elif code == 'p':
                result.append(r'([AP]M)')
            elif code == 'M':
                result.append(r'(\d{1,2})')
            elif code == 'S':
                result.append(r'(\d{1,2})')
            elif code == 'f':
                result.append(r'(\d+)')
            elif code == 'z':
                # Flexible timezone: ±HHMM[SS[.ffffff]] or ±HH:MM
